name: software-dock
description: List, update, install and uninstall the software on this Windows PC, see what is running and what starts with Windows.
long_description: The software inventory of a Windows PC for AI agents: everything in Settings › Installed apps reconciled with WinGet and the Microsoft Store, pending updates (exploited ones first, from CISA's KEV catalog), running apps with CPU and memory, startup apps, unused apps and a backup in `winget import` format. Install, upgrade and uninstall go through WinGet or the app's own uninstaller, never with guessed silent switches. Requires WinGet (App Installer), preinstalled on current Windows.

tools.name: list_installed_software
tools.description: Installed apps with version, available update and key

tools.name: get_software_details
